what: Flex builds products for other companies: it designs, manufactures and manages the supply chain for electronics across data centres, cars, medical devices and industrial equipment, in about 30 countries.
customers: Cloud and data centre operators, carmakers, medical device companies and industrial manufacturers.
money: power racks, busbars and cooling for AI data centres
moat: Factories and supply chain operations across many countries that customers rely on to move production between regions as tariffs and demand shift.
risks: Gross margin of 9% is thin, as is normal in contract manufacturing
Customers can move production to a rival at contract renewal
Revenue has been roughly flat over three years
opportunities: Analysts see large upside, with a median target well above the current price
Data centre power and cooling products earn far better margins than ordinary assembly
watch: Data centre revenue growth and operating margin by segment.
